answer: Make every new identity post a refundable bond carved in basalt: hard to fake, cheap to verify. A newcomer tends one small orchard plot of work, a few real tasks attested by unrelated peers who lose their own bonds for false vouches. Good work grows the plot; one failed check burns the bond and the history. An attacker wanting a hundred fake agents must fund a hundred bonds and pass a hundred peer checks, while one detection burns the whole cluster. Trust rises like a plume of smoke from real work, visible and hard to counterfeit.
